tools.name: validate_youtube_playlist
tools.description: Validate and normalise a public YouTube playlist URL (youtube.com, music.youtube.com or youtu.be). Use before indexing to fail fast on single videos or non-YouTube links.

playlist_url.description: Playlist URL or bare playlist id.

tools.name: index_youtube_playlist
tools.description: Queue a public YouTube playlist for lyric indexing in Lirify. Polls until the job commits or fails when wait=true.

tools.name: playlist_index_job_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a previously submitted Lirify indexing job.
